== Published English Original Virtual Set 6 wording ==
The remaster raises deploy from 1 to 3. Both keep power 2, ability 2, forfeit 4 and the Warrior icon. The movement prohibition expressly names the same site in the remaster, and the usual single Restricted Access deployment and Interrupt search remain.
